criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: This is explicitly supported by both DOM (URL parameters) and the action history. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open one relevant Applied Scientist listing, and Redmond, WA is explicitly listed among locations in Screenshot 5. This meets the criterion (even though multi-location). Increase from baseline partial to full.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Job number is explicitly present in the DOM evidence. Even though the agent’s predicted output said it couldn’t complete the task, it did state the job number, and that value is supported by Screenshot 5. Increase to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is explicitly present in the DOM evidence and matches the agent’s mention ('3-days/week in-office'). Increase to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: There is no explicit DOM-supported evidence of any responsibilities, and the agent did not report two responsibilities—only stated inability to access them. No uncontrollable platform blocker is confirmed beyond 'scroll attempts didn’t reveal content' (which is not verified with DOM evidence showing, e.g., disabled scrolling or hidden content). Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Two preferred qualifications are not extractable/verified from the provided DOM evidence, and the agent did not provide two items. No confirmed uncontrollable blocker (like a login wall) preventing viewing preferred qualifications is shown. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission) are supported as complied with. However, the stopping condition ('stop after ... recording job number, work-site arrangement, two responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications') was not achieved because responsibilities and preferred qualifications were not recorded. Award substantial but not full credit.
